news.headline: Wet and windy conditions at Soldier Field put a damper on both teams' passing games, and Swift wound up leading Chicago
news.detail: Wet and windy conditions at Soldier Field put a damper on both teams' passing games, and Swift wound up leading Chicago in receiving yards while tying Kalif Raymond for the team lead in receptions. Swift also had the Bears' longest play from scrimmage, a 32-year catch-and-run in the fourth quarter.
